questions.question: What does a constructor do?
options: It initializes the object when it is created
It prints data on the screen
explanations: Constructors have no return type.
Correct. The constructor runs when the object is created with new.
Constructors do not destroy objects.
Printing is the job of a regular method.

questions.question: Which keyword is used to reference the current object?
explanations: self does not exist in Java.
Correct. this references the current object.
current is not a keyword.
object is not a keyword.

questions.question: What happens if you do not define any constructor?
options: Java automatically creates an empty constructor
Java assigns null values to everything
explanations: There is no error if you do not define constructors.
Correct. Java implicitly creates a no-argument constructor.
It can be created.
Attributes receive default values, not all null.

questions.question: How do you call another constructor from within a constructor?
explanations: super() calls the superclass constructor.
Correct. this() calls another constructor of the same class.
new() is not used that way.
constructor() is not valid.
